description:
⚠️ WRITE OPERATION - Confirm with user before calling. Creates a new API key for the specified service account. The secret is
returned once at creation and cannot be retrieved again.

> Note: Only a regular user can perform this operation.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the user within the account.

expiration_period_days.description: The number of days until the API key expires. Defaults to 90. Maximum is 365.

key_value.description: The public identifier of the API key.

key_secret.description: The secret portion of the API key. Only returned at creation time and cannot be retrieved again.

key_status.description: The status of the API key. Possible values: `ACTIVE`: The key has a single active secret, `ACTIVE_GRACE`:  The key has two active secrets during rotation overlap, and `EXPIRED`: The key has expired.

created_at.description: The timestamp that the user created their API key

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the API key expires.
